_meta.title: RIO methodology reference data — Village Needs Methodology v5.0
_meta.requirement: RIO-AI-005 (legacy FR-19) — approved methodology implementation baseline
_meta.signOff: Dr. Zulfiqar, July 2026 (METH — Change Summary v5.0)
_meta.countNote: 193 = the full instrument. 186 = field items (193 minus the 7 questionnaire-structure/roster/template modules XDM-01..07). 184 = questions actually fielded to households (186 minus WSH-15, answered from an administrative record, and SOC-08, on hold under the sensitivity protocol). 166 = items carrying a severity score. These describe the same bank at different scopes.

questions.kpi: HLT-01 — % of villages with a functioning primary health facility within 5 km

questions.targetRespondent: Head of household or an informed adult respondent
questions.reportMapping: Village Scorecard · Domain Comparison · Priority Classification

questions.kpi: HLT-02 — Travel time to the nearest functioning health facility
